sub_graphs.title: EIP-7872: Local Builder Blob Limit Configuration

nodes.label: Builder Configuration Loaded

nodes.label: Protocol Blob Limit Known
nodes.description: MAX_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK protocol parameter is available

nodes.label: Calculate Effective Blob Limit
nodes.description: Compute min(MAX_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK, USER_CONFIGURED_MAX_BLOBS_PER_BLOCK)

nodes.label: Effective Limit is Zero
nodes.description: Calculated minimum equals zero

nodes.label: Apply Minimum Floor of One
nodes.description: Override zero limit to ensure at least one blob can be included

nodes.label: Effective Blob Limit Computed
nodes.description: Final blob limit for block building is determined

nodes.label: Build Block Respecting Limit
nodes.description: Include blobs from mempool up to the computed effective limit

nodes.label: Block Built with Constrained Blobs
nodes.description: Block is constructed with blobs within the builder's configured limit

sub_graphs.description: Models the default configuration state and its relationship to fork parameters

nodes.description: User has not specified USER_CONFIGURED_MAX_BLOBS_PER_BLOCK

ambiguities.text: The specification does not define how USER_CONFIGURED_MAX_BLOBS_PER_BLOCK is specified in configuration files
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume it follows standard client configuration patterns (CLI flags, config file, or environment variable).

ambiguities.text: The relationship between MAX_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK and blob count is not explicitly defined
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume MAX_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK divided by gas-per-blob gives the maximum blob count, and the comparison is done at the blob count level.

implicit_assumptions.description: Builders can accurately estimate their bandwidth capacity and configure the limit appropriately
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Misconfigured limits could still cause propagation failures (if set too high) or unnecessary revenue loss (if set too low).

implicit_assumptions.description: Network conditions are stable enough that a static configuration is effective
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Varying network conditions might require dynamic adjustment of blob limits rather than static configuration.

implicit_assumptions.description: Local builders using this feature are honest and not using it to manipulate blob inclusion
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Builders could artificially restrict blob inclusion to manipulate blob gas prices or exclude competitors' transactions.
